notes.title: Kanji Drive Version 1.2 - Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Kanji Drive Version 1.2[/b][/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222664/c6ee013478e00fc62c5df6d883976f26468b953e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222664/c6ee013478e00fc62c5df6d883976f26468b953e.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Native aspect ratio is changed from 2:1 to 16:10. Every text and graphic is now adjusted for this new aspect ratio.

[*] With the change of aspect ratio, there is now more road visible on the screen, the car is also below where it used to be. It got slightly easier to react to incoming flashcards

[*] There are now Steam Achievements for the game. 7 of them: 
[olist]
[*] Can be gained by Leveling Up
[*] Selling a Kanji from the Dictionary
[*] Earning and holding 1000+ EPs
[*] Giving your date a gift
[*] Finishing all the dates
[*] Farming 10 Wheat
[*] Changing the Skin of your Car
[/olist]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222664/f75ea637e80a6e7582ddb0617c0327977fbb855e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222664/f75ea637e80a6e7582ddb0617c0327977fbb855e.jpg[/img][/url]

[*] A bug that made the car glitch out in the middle road when V-sync was On is now fixed.

[*] "Adaptive V-sync" and "Double V-sync" options are removed. Code is optimized to allow for regular V-sync to work well. There are only V-sync On and Off options.

[*] Scanlines are removed. Now there are square light lines that react to the car and "lighten the road" while causing a texture effect. 

[*] Resolution setting is redone. Previous scaling system is gone and is swapped with option to pick from most popular resolutions.

[*] Game can now be played in Fullscreen (F key in Keyboard & the Start button on the Gamepad)

[*] It is now more much more easier to encounter an event. (It used to be event per 25 uninterrupted kilometers, now it is 15.) This can allow for adding more interesting events to the game in the future.

[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222664/e389e107bb2d9c4f93cc0a238a74ca9bf351663d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222664/e389e107bb2d9c4f93cc0a238a74ca9bf351663d.jpg[/img][/url]
